info.title: Q0 Application Service API Documentation
info.description:
Interactive API Documentation for the Q0 Application Service microservice. The main backend for the Q0 platform handling auth, models, deployments, training, datasets, billing, knowledge bases, and more.

Note: All endpoints accept both plain JSON and AES-encrypted payloads. Swagger UI automatically encrypts requests and decrypts responses via interceptors. Testers can use plain JSON directly.

post.summary: Get batch inference job by ID

post.description: Returns combined trend-regression and usage-simulation forecasts. The authenticated member must have active access to the requested organization. The service resolves the organization's wallet internally; wallet_id and base_spend cannot be supplied by the caller.

403.description: The authenticated member does not have active access to the organization

404.description: Organization wallet or forecast data not found

date_range.description: Preset date range. Last 1 Month is the previous 30 days.

company_id.description: Organization whose wallet will be used for forecasting

months.description: Number of future months to forecast

base_spend.description: Starting spend selected by the upstream service, in INR
